---
name: Extension proposal
about: Suggest a focused community extension or discuss a substantial addition
---

<!-- Do not include credentials, private project data, or sensitive logs.
Report vulnerabilities through SECURITY.md, not through this template. -->

## Problem and intended users

What workflow would this improve? Is there an existing extension that could cover it?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the user-facing commands, tools, UI, or event handling. Use supported AiderDesk APIs where known; call out API gaps rather than assuming new ones exist.

## Suggested ID and layout

Proposed stable ID, single-file or folder layout, and any build needs:

## Dependencies and trust considerations

List npm packages, external executables/services, credentials, costs, data sent off-device, and filesystem/network/subprocess access. Say explicitly when none are needed.

## Compatibility and limitations

Target AiderDesk version(s), operating systems, known limitations, and testing approach:

## Maintenance and licensing

Are you willing to implement or maintain it? Identify third-party code/assets and their licenses; no commitment is required to propose an idea.
